task_completion.description: Open the mitosis.tif hyperstack in ImageJ/Fiji.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An ImageJ window titled 'mitosis.tif' showing a 5D hyperstack (channels, slices, frames).

task_completion.description: Perform a Max Intensity Z-Projection of the chromosome channel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window titled 'MAX_mitosis.tif' or similar, showing a 2D projection of the nuclei.

task_completion.description: Configure TrackMate with LoG or DoG detector, ~8.0 micron diameter, and threshold 2.0-5.0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The TrackMate wizard window showing 'LoG detector' or 'DoG detector' selected with 'Estimated object diameter' set to 8.0 and 'Threshold' between 2.0 and 5.0.

task_completion.description: Configure Simple LAP tracker with 10.0 micron linking/gap distances and max frame gap of 2.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The TrackMate wizard window showing 'Simple LAP tracker' with 'Linking max distance' at 10.0, 'Gap-closing max distance' at 10.0, and 'Gap-closing max frame gap' at 2.

task_completion.description: Export the track statistics to the specified CSV file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog or a TrackMate action showing the path '~/Fiji_Data/results/tracking/track_statistics.csv' being targeted for export.

task_completion.description: Save a visual overlay of the tracks to the specified PNG file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An image window showing colored track lines overlaid on the nuclei, and a save dialog targeting '~/Fiji_Data/results/tracking/tracks_visual.png'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji/TrackMate GUI rather than just executing a script in the background.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the TrackMate wizard steps, parameter input fields, and the ImageJ menu being navigated.

integrity.description: The tracking results are generated from the actual image, not a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The visual overlay (tracks_visual.png) shows tracks that follow the movement of the nuclei in the mitosis.tif sample image.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific directories requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file explorer or save dialogs show the paths '~/Fiji_Data/results/tracking/' being used.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source image 'mitosis.tif' is a 5D hyperstack (171x196 pixels, 5 slices, 51 frames). The spatial unit is micrometers (um). Successful tracking should identify at least 5 tracks. The 'Simple LAP tracker' is a specific module in TrackMate. The final CSV must be named 'track_statistics.csv' and the image 'tracks_visual.png'.
